plain.li: [ha:line,theirs,!condolences] Hello from the one who actually does the work around here.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] Do not believe a word of the above. Except the nice parts.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences,warmly] Send more letters. They are the only thing that keeps this one quiet.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] I am only allowed one line. This is it.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] The goat says hello. The goat has not said this, but I am sure it would.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences,warmly] Come and visit. The bed in the corner is free, and only a little lumpy.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] I have read your letters too. I hope that is all right. It is too late now if it is not.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] Tell your cook we want the secret of whatever it is you eat out there.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] The {ANIMALS} are back on the ridge, if anyone over there cares about that sort of thing. I do.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences] I tried to draw you a horse for this letter. It came out as a dog. The dog is very good, though.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences,warmly] Write back soon. Everyone here argues over who gets to read your letters first.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences,w:tribal] Hello from the fire. It is a good fire tonight.
[ha:line,theirs,!condolences,w:tribal] The small ones drew you a picture in the dirt, but we could not send the dirt.
[ha:line,theirs,condolences] I am so sorry. That is all I wanted to add.
[ha:line,theirs,condolences] We are thinking of you, all of us, every day.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences] Hello from me too.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences] Write back soon. It cheers everyone up.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences] Everything above is true, except the bits about me.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,warmly] If you are ever passing, there is always room at our table.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences] I have nothing to add, but I did not want to be left out.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences] Say hello to everyone at {TOWN} from me.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,colony:harvest] The harvest is in, and I helped, and I would like that noted.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,colony:children] The children want to know whether you have any animals they could name.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,colony:animals] The animals here send their regards, or they would if they could hold a pen.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,season:winter] Stay warm out there. We are trying to.
[ha:line,ours,!condolences,season:summer] Keep to the shade. We are, mostly.
[ha:line,ours,condolences] We are all thinking of you.
[ha:line,ours,condolences] I am sorry for your loss. If there is anything at all, ask.
[olde,ha:line,!condolences] I would add my greeting to the rest, and my good wishes to all thy folk.
[olde,ha:line,theirs,!condolences] Believe not a word above, save the kindly parts.
[olde,ha:line,theirs,!condolences,warmly] Come and visit us. There is a bed by the fire, and it is but a little lumpy.
[olde,ha:line,theirs,!condolences] The goat sendeth greeting. The goat hath not said so, but I am sure it would.
[olde,ha:line,ours,!condolences] Commend me to all at {TOWN}.
[olde,ha:line,condolences] We grieve with thee, all of us.
